改變，背離

example: The bus driver swerved to avoid hitting a cyclist.
為了不撞上騎自行車的人，這輛公共汽車只好緊急轉彎。
She is one of those rare politicians whom one can trust not to swerve from policy and principle.
她是一位難得可以信賴的政治家，不會背離自己的政策和原則。
Compare
unswerving
